purpose: Correctness smoke only; not a performance experiment.
control: Ordinary live-slot continuation forked from the same source K/V cells.
treatment: Commit newly evaluated cells to the source sequence, remove request membership, then reattach the complete source range.

important_control_result.observation: An intermediate independently generated branch produced the same first-turn tokens but diverged on the second turn; the final fresh-prefill control did not reproduce that divergence.
important_control_result.interpretation: Fresh-prefill numerical reproducibility requires a separate paired study and is not a substitute for same-state PRA equivalence. K/V reuse correctness must be tested by forking the same captured source state.
